name: 48105 · Ann Arbor, MI
findings: ZIP 48105 (Ann Arbor) has 201 nonprofit organizations. 100 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48105 (Ann Arbor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do research and think tank organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 26 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
